$comment: Four entries of vendor/vuln-triage.json, one for each id in osv.json, for tests/unit/vuln-watch.test.ts, which holds each to its committed entry while the committed triage still has it.
The note of CVE-2026-76844 reflects the live CVE record, which no longer rates its vector; cve.json still holds the 2026-11-04 reading that did.

entries.reason: The compromised eMudhra intermediates chain to emSign Root TLS CA - G3, emSign Root CS CA - G3, AAA Certificate Services (through Sectigo's cross-signs) and emSign ECC Root CA - G3 (the disclosure's roots.json), and the locked certifi 2026.10.19 carries none of them (read at its 2026.10.19 tag, which restored only the unaffected emSign roots), so the engine's feed downloads, which requests verifies against that bundle, refuse such a chain by default. They reach it when REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE, which the app passes to the engine, names a bundle that still carries one of those roots, and a certifi bump cannot close that path, since certifi holds roots, not a denylist of intermediates, and that bundle is not certifi's. OSV lists 3.12.0-3.12.15 as affected; 3.12.16, in python-build-standalone 20261026, carries the denylist, so the fix is a pin move.

The same issue as CVE-2026-115557, under the PSF's id. The locked certifi 2026.10.19 carries none of the roots the compromised intermediates chain to, but REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE, which the app passes to the engine, can name a bundle that does, and only the denylist in CPython 3.12.16 refuses the chain then. OSV lists 3.12.0-3.12.15 as affected.
The loop is in the DASH demuxer, which the pinned build does not compile: its demuxers are image2, mov and gif alone (ADR-040).

The overflow is in gz_write, after a failed write through gzwrite. Nothing that carries zlib 1.3.2 writes through the gz* file API: the two copies left at 1.3.2 are python312.dll on Windows, which compiles none of zlib's gz*.c files (PCbuild/pythoncore.vcxproj at v3.12.16 lists adler32, compress, crc32, deflate, infback, inffast, inflate, inftrees, trees, uncompr and zutil, and zlibmodule.c calls only deflate, inflate, crc32 and adler32), and the static zlib in the Windows FFmpeg, whose 9.0.1 sources have no gz* call anywhere, so its libz.a never pulls in gzwrite.o.
entries.rating_note: Rated high by hand, on an earlier rating of this same vector. OSV's record, and its alias GHSA-g84c-rxfj-3j2c, describe this zlib flaw. The CVE record under the id, read 2026-11-13, describes an unrelated webpack-dev-middleware flaw and rates other vectors, so nothing now rates the vector OSV gives. The CVE record as it read on 2026-11-04 (recorded in tests/fixtures/vuln-watch/cve.json, cut down to its metrics) gave this exact vector as 8.3 HIGH, and that is what the rating rests on; no score was computed here. Reread when the CVE record is corrected.
